content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for JIPMER Senior Clinical Research Coordinator Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post name for the JIPMER recruitment?
faq.answer: The post name for the JIPMER recruitment is Senior Clinical Research Coordinator.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy available for the Senior Clinical Research Coordinator post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is Walk-in.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled for 04 September 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the educational qualification required?
faq.answer: The required educational qualification is M.Sc. in Clinical research or life sciences, Pharm.D/M.Pharm, and ICH-GCP Certification.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for the post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the post is 35 years.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary offered?
faq.answer: The salary offered is Rs. 45000 - 60000 Per Month.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: The selection process includes a Written Test, Skill Test, Interview, and Document Verification.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for any category.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the walk-in interview venue?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at the JIPMER office in Puducherry.
